narrative.overview:
A calm, technical portfolio with a recognisable human presence. Dark green graphite, faint dots, a pale green accent, and clear typography frame engineering evidence and a careful exploration of security.

The binary portrait is the signature. Its source is Paul's user-selected hoodie photograph (Photo 3); a local circular window reveals the aligned real photograph within six layers of binary text. The floating capsule header keeps identity and actions accessible while the page scrolls. Interaction supports reading and investigation, with complete reading and action paths when motion is reduced.

Current scope restores six services, 32 unique skills, six roles with all 27 original bullets, seven testimonials, eight genuine projects, and three full articles across the shared shell. The Programming Buddies internship is September 2026–present with five role-level bullets grounded in supplied activity notes (32 total résumé bullets, retaining all 27 originals); Union Bank ends August 2026. The optional client-only simulated console and source-content project explorer extend the established world in code, inspired by uibeawuchi.com without borrowing claims. Original database/fallback access is unchanged; explicit LagosNet/reconciliation cases now use getProjectBySlug. Project assets are genuine published rasters with local mapping and provenance sidecars.

**Current verification boundary:** the restored site and new console/explorer have source, build, parser, content-parity, and generated-HTML evidence. Final visual, browser, and runtime QA is incomplete. Automatic approval review denied localhost access because of the account usage limit; no retry or alternate access method was used. There are no current screenshots or whole-UI SHIP verdict. Historical browser checks and SHIP decisions apply only to the earlier, narrower implementation.

The user selected direction C from the right column of the second concept board. The open P, shaped T, and rounded geometric lettering are a font-free vector interpretation of that approved imagegen concept, not a bitmap crop or exact-tracing claim. src/data/brandGeometry.json is canonical: BrandLogo, wordmark, P+T icon, favicons, and loading mark reuse the same paths. No body font or palette changes accompany the identity. The canonical P+T icon, wordmark, header expansion, favicon and pending indicator share geometry. This supersedes the former text PT size/reveal; static artwork proof is not rendered UI or motion evidence. Browser verification remains incomplete.

The user-approved full-screen Matrix loader replaces the rejected small pending badge. Canonical direction-C SVG resolves through deterministic binary/mixed glyphs to the full name, capped at 520px/76vw, with exact label Loading. Presentation progress is not downloaded bytes: actual pending work caps it at 95%; ready enables 100%. Skip/Escape, 10-second release, static reduced-motion identity, wall-clock hidden-tab handling, default-hidden SSR overlay and client-only inert/focus/scroll lifecycle provide source-inspected recovery. Header geometry/hover, assets and palette are unchanged. Browser verification remains incomplete.

The user-approved local Role explorer replaces experience disclosures with a company/date rail and complete role articles, preserving six roles, all 32 responsibilities, exact dates, both anchors and the résumé PDF. Skills and experience use full-width sections with headings above the content, following the user’s newest preference and superseding the earlier screenshot-based constraint. Other sections preserve the established editorial layout and ≤900px outer stacking. Component-width queries adapt the inner patterns: Role explorer narrows its rail at ≤800px and places two selector columns above details at ≤600px; Signal map uses its compact hub/two-tool-column arrangement at ≤650px. Existing viewport fallbacks remain. Programming Buddies opens first. Client enhancement selects one article; no-JavaScript reading and print rules retain every complete role. The finite selection entrance has a still reduced-motion path. Source/build/generated-output evidence does not verify current rendering, interaction, assistive technology or print. This extension remains local and uncommitted pending the final commit/push, explicitly authorized by the user’s latest instruction. Production deployment remains unverified.

rules.name: The Restrained Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve accent for actions, active states, and deliberate emphasis; keep the baseline dotted ground faint.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Confine character disturbance to the portrait; links, labels, headings, and prose stay stable and readable.

rules.name: The Still Access Rule
rules.body: Reduced-motion and touch presentation preserve the portrait, all content, and every action without dependence on animation.

dos: Do keep role positioning and résumé access immediately legible.
Do preserve the source-photo binary portrait and aligned local reveal.
Do keep synthetic events and reconstructed project visuals explicitly labelled.
Do retain complete reading and action paths in still and reduced-motion states.
Do use shared tokens, local fonts, and scoped security styles consistently.
donts: Don't invent internship duties, certifications, labs, or security engagements beyond the supplied role and content.
Don't spread the character effect into links or reading text.
Don't treat finite Figma states as proof of browser behavior; use runtime evidence.
Don't turn the subdued dotted field into a competing foreground effect.
